name: linear-modal-center-content

frames.best_why: Frame 4 shows the settled expanded card with photo, large title, description and close button.

tagline: A photo tile springs open into a full centered article card.
summary: Three photo cards that expand into one large centered reading panel when clicked. The backdrop blurs, the picture stays on top and the text fades in below it.
appearance: Three tall photo tiles in a row on a black page, each with a small title bottom-left and a round plus button bottom-right. Open, one becomes a tall rounded panel: a full-width photo above a heading, a paragraph of small text and an X at the top right.
behaviour: Clicking a tile grows it with a spring into a centered tall card while the page behind blurs and dims. The image, title and text scale and fade in; the X closes it back to the row.
demo_content: Cards named Accordion, Globe Section and Image Mouse Trail over lattice, dune and plant photos
search_phrases: photo card that opens into an article
click a picture to read more
card morphs into full screen panel
gallery tile opens a large view
use_when: A gallery of photos should open into readable detail without leaving the page.
avoid_when: Each card carries a long hardcoded description and a remote image, so text and art need source edits.
customise: The items array holds image URL, title, description and tags; spring, radii and panel size live in the source.
weight_why: Three cards and one spring layout animation; the blur is CSS.

a11y.note: Cards open on click only; the trigger is a div with no keyboard handler, and photos use empty alt text.

issues: The trigger card is a div, so it cannot be opened from the keyboard.
Every photo has empty alt text, so the images are unnamed for screen readers.
polish_why: Convincing spring morph and a clean reading panel; keyboard access and alt text are missing.
